component.name: TrinityOne Suite
component.summary: Your church on your own computer — messaging, groups, Bible, care and safeguarding

description.p: TrinityOne Suite is everything a church needs to stay connected, in one desktop app. It includes:

ul.li: a steward console for managing members, groups, rotas, events and a calendar
pastoral care with meal trains and help requests
a full Bible reader with reading plans and devotionals
a directory and children's register with safeguarding controls

description.p: It also runs your church's own relay — the small server that keeps your congregation's messages and data with the church, not a third party.
Install it, set up your church in a few minutes, and share the address with your members.
